sloka: भरतेन वयं पश्चात्समानीता निरर्थकम् ।हता हि राक्षसाः क्षिप्रं पार्थिवैः स्युर्न संशयः ।। ७.३९.४ ॥
transliteration: bharatena vayaṁ paścātsamānītā nirarthakam ।hatā hi rākṣasāḥ kṣipraṁ pārthivaiḥ syurna saṁśayaḥ ।। 7.39.4 ॥

translations.english: They felt that they had been brought uselessly by Bharata, as the Rakshasas would have certainly been quickly killed by the kings themselves.
